idea-plugin.name: C++ Modules Language Server
idea-plugin.description:
C++20 named modules that work on any compiler. mcpp-language-server normalizes how the project is built — mcpp, CMake, a compile_commands.json, or nothing — into one module description, drives its own pinned clangd with it, and answers module-level requests.

The server must be on PATH: download payload-<platform>.tar.gz from the release page, unpack it and put its payload/bin directory on PATH.
